headline: Innovana Thinklabs Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Pursuant to provision of Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulation ), we hereby inform you that the Board of…
detail: Acquisition - Pursuant to provision of Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulation ), we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of Innovana Thinklabs Limited ("the Company"), at its meeting held today, i.e., July 21, 2026, has approved the acquisition of 0.30% equity stake in Mount Everest Breweries Limited.
